review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for coordinateNorm, normPolynomial and NormForm and found nothing. I also checked the polyCharpoly API in Mathlib/Algebra/Module/LinearMap/Polynomial.lean. It has polyCharpoly_eq_of_basis and polyCharpoly_baseChange but no reindex or change-of-basis lemma, so the private helper lemmas here are not competing definitions. coordinateNorm wraps Algebra.norm with b.equivFun.symm. coordinateChange is just b'.equivFun.symm.trans b.equivFun. coordinateChangePolynomial is defined directly through LinearMap.toMvPolynomial. All three are thin named specialisations built from existing Mathlib notions, not independent competing versions. I found no concrete cost such as duplicated API or repeated conversions. I did not search for other possible overlaps outside Mathlib's polynomial and norm files, and I did not search the other Formal Frontier libraries.
